detail.longDescription: 🤖 Bell Canada confirms an "agentic" threat actor breached its systems on Nov 17 and exfiltrated enterprise customer data, including records from a system used to order and provision telecom circuits. No root cause or entry point disclosed yet. 🔗 https://www. bleepingcomputer.com/news/secu rity/bell-canada-says-agentic-hacker-stole-enterprise-customer-data/ # DataBreach # InfoSec # AgenticAI
